ordinary.schedule: reference,candidate with session order 1,2; candidate,reference with session order 2,1
ordinary.analysis: Divide candidate by reference process medians within each matched session order, then take the median of those two ratios. Keep both ratios for each stage and session count.
ordinary.gate: All numerical signatures and workspace sizes match. Two-session decode median ratio <= 0.99. Prefill and one-session decode median ratios <= 1.05 for each session count or stage where applicable.

resident.schedule: Reference/reference and reference/candidate pairs in each round. Alternate pair position every round. In two-round blocks swap the starting arm independently of pair position, and alternate the first arm at each token.
resident.analysis: For each case and comparison divide right by left seven-call sums and take the median over rounds. Keep both starting-arm strata, both pair-position strata, and the same-path controls.
resident.gate: Exact token IDs, logit and KV hashes, positions and workspace. Same-path total medians in [0.97, 1.03] for every case. At each two-session prefix require output head ratio <= 0.95, total ratio <= 0.99, at least 6 of 8 total wins and both starting-arm total medians < 1. One-session total ratio <= 1.03 in both cases.

adoption: Exercise ordinary and resident gates plus focused numerical/fallback and race checks, and the clean tree checks. Use both alignment tiling and a cached executor callback if they pass; the cached callback separately must remove the warm allocation on the paired path. No Q4 runtime changes, or three-output dispatch, in this candidate.
